about_the_game:
Are you enjoying Critter Isle? Do you want to support us in our mission to make fun games?

We made Critter Isle free to put player experience first! We believe in the importance of community feedback, it's what drives us to do better. Whether it's reviewing and rating the game, sharing it, or asking us directly in Discord, we encourage it all!

When you purchase the Supporter Pack, you directly tell us that you enjoyed the game, believe in the game, and believe in us! We will not take that for granted.

As a thank you for supporting us, you will receive a few cosmetic assets to spice up the look of your game:

-"Supporter" badge, found on the main menu

-Unique border designs for the clock

-Different boat designs, randomly selected when the boat is called

-And 12 fun hats that your Egglins can wear during their stay on your island

And if you can't support us through this DLC, don't worry! Simply playing the game is a win for us, and we appreciate all the time and effort you put into it.

short_description: The Supporter Pack is a great way for you to show your support for Critter Isle, while also helping us at Pixel Frog! This, of course, is optional but does come with some cool cosmetics to show off in-game.
